name: Crosshair-TS-TW
blurb: Custom crosshair cursor with horizontal and vertical lines tracking the pointer.
description: Renders a custom crosshair that tracks the pointer with smooth animation. Lines animate with SVG turbulence filter for glitch effect. Scoped to optional container element.
use_when: Premium interactive experiences, gaming interfaces, or targeting/precision tools.
avoid_when: Accessibility-focused designs; custom cursors override user preferences.
a11y: Custom cursor replaces default pointer. SVG filters have no aria labels. No keyboard support.
